description: workflow/04a_multiclass_selection.smk, pilot of criterion E9 (docs/experiment_plan.md, section 5d): the 'linear' learner with the two metrics of the Maternal jobs of experiment C on every candidate that passed E1-E8, same file and fold column in R and Python.
